objects.name: actor
objects.description: A member of the agency, or an agent acting for one.

objects.name: group
objects.description: A node of the agency's structure — whatever its levels call one.

objects.name: actor_group_assignment
objects.description: One member's registration in one node of the structure.

objects.name: role_kind
objects.description: A kind of seat the agency's members can be granted.

objects.name: actor_role_assignment
objects.description: One seat held by one member in one node, live or ended.

objects.name: hierarchy
objects.description: One named tree of levels the agency's structure is built from.

objects.name: level
objects.description: One rung of the agency's tree.

objects.name: group_type
objects.description: The agency's own noun for the nodes at one level.

objects.name: group_join_request
objects.description: A member's request to join a node of the structure that needs approval.

objects.name: join_decision
objects.description: One approval or decline of a member's request to join, kept as it was made.

objects.name: group_invitation
objects.description: An invitation from a node's leaders to one person to join it, which is how a hidden node is reached.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The counters behind every coded type's stable identifier.

objects.name: code_format
objects.description: How the agency's member and group codes are drawn.
